signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to continue today’s work.
signIn.remember: Remember my username on this PC
signIn.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

pin.title: Quick sign in
pin.subtitle: Pick your name and enter your PIN.
pin.none: No one has a PIN yet. The owner adds cashiers in Settings → Users & permissions.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.twoStep: If you sign in with a code from your phone (like the owner), you can choose a new password now. You need the 6-digit code from the app and one of your printed recovery codes.
forgot.staff: Otherwise, ask the owner to reset it in Settings → Users & permissions. You will choose a new one at your next sign-in.

server.down: Can’t reach the main server. Check that the server PC is on and the network is connected.
server.untrusted: The server at this address is not the ARTÉPOOL server this PC was enrolled with, so this PC will not connect to it. Ask the owner to check the network.

secondFactor.title: Owner verification
secondFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
secondFactor.useApp: Use the code from the app
secondFactor.recoveryHint: One of the 10 codes you printed when you set up the 2-step code. Each code works once.
secondFactor.trustHint: The phone code will not be asked on this PC during that time. Do not tick this on a PC other people use.

change.passwordSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one that only you know.
change.pinSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary PIN. Choose 4 digits that only you know.
change.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess. No symbols needed.
change.pinHint: 4 digits. Easy patterns such as 1234, 1111 or 1212 are refused.
change.mismatch: The two entries are not the same.

problems.too_short: Too short: use at least {minLength} characters.
problems.contains_username: It must not contain your username.
problems.one_character: It must not be one character repeated.
problems.same_as_current: It must be different from the current one.
problems.weak: Too easy to guess (for example 1234, 1111 or 1212).

twoStep.title: Set up the 2-step code
twoStep.subtitle: This protects the owner account. You need your phone with an authenticator app, for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
twoStep.again: You signed in with a recovery code, so set up the 2-step code again. Your remaining recovery codes stop working and you get 10 new ones.
twoStep.scan: 1. Scan this code with the app.
twoStep.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key in the app instead:
twoStep.enter: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
twoStep.incomplete: Enter the 6 digits from the app.

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.subtitle: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Print them or write them down and keep them in the safe. They are shown only now.
recovery.saved: I have printed or written down these codes

enroll.title: Enroll this PC
enroll.subtitle: Connect this PC to the ARTÉPOOL main server, once. Ask the owner for an enrollment code: Settings → Devices → Enroll a PC.
enroll.serverHint: The main server PC’s name or IP address, for example artepool-server or 192.168.1.10.
enroll.codeHint: 9 characters, like K7Q-4MX-92P. It works once, for 10 minutes.
enroll.name: PC name
enroll.nameHint: Shown to the owner in Settings → Devices, for example Showroom counter.
enroll.kindHint: Cashiers can sign in with a PIN only on POS counters; office PCs always need a password.
enroll.missing: Fill in the server address, the code and the PC name.
enroll.revoked: This PC was revoked by the owner. It can be enrolled again with a new code.
enroll.expired: This PC’s key has expired. Enroll it again with a new code.

failures.invalid_address: That server address is not valid. Type the server PC’s name or IP address.
failures.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the address and that the server PC is on.
failures.not_genuine: The code is wrong or expired, or the server at that address is not the ARTÉPOOL server. Check both; ask the owner for a new code if needed.
failures.code_rejected: The code was refused: it expired or was already used. Ask the owner for a new code.
failures.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
failures.unavailable: The server cannot enroll PCs right now. Ask the owner to check the server.

passwordRecovery.title: Choose a new password
passwordRecovery.subtitle: Prove it is you with your phone and one of your printed recovery codes.
passwordRecovery.left: {count} of your recovery codes are left. Each one works once; keep them in a safe place.
passwordRecovery.ended: You were signed out on every other PC, and no PC is trusted any more: the phone code is asked again everywhere.
